name: chrome-extension-collection
description: Open-source workspace for focused Chrome extensions.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.release:bugtrace:major: pnpm --dir extensions/bugtrace-recorder version major --tag-version-prefix=bugtrace-recorder-v -m "publish(bugtrace-recorder): release v%s"
scripts.release:bugtrace:minor: pnpm --dir extensions/bugtrace-recorder version minor --tag-version-prefix=bugtrace-recorder-v -m "publish(bugtrace-recorder): release v%s"
scripts.release:bugtrace:patch: pnpm --dir extensions/bugtrace-recorder version patch --tag-version-prefix=bugtrace-recorder-v -m "publish(bugtrace-recorder): release v%s"
